important_nonordering: Future-behavior and value sufficiency are different partial orders/targets.
Proof/certificate sufficiency may be finer than ordinary q_o.
Representation cardinality on a finite test is not itself a proof of semantic minimality.
Direct recomputation from the complete current position and self-contained recursive maintenance are distinct realization constraints.
A representation may be semantically sufficient at each rank yet fail recursive closure because safely forgotten information can become relevant after a move.
